name: M1 member modifiers
text: class A { public static readonly x = 1; static public y; private private z; declare readonly w: number; override accessor v = 1; protected async m() {} }

name: M2 abstract members
text: abstract class A { abstract m(): void; protected abstract readonly p: number; abstract get g(): number; }

name: M3 optional definite members
text: class A { a?: number; b!: number; c?(): void; static d?: string; e? = 1; }

name: M4 parameter properties
text: class A { constructor(private readonly x: number, public y?: string, protected override z = 1, readonly private w = 2) {} }

name: M5 optional params
text: function f(a?: number, b?, ...c) {}

name: M6 arrow optional params
text: var g = (a?, b?: number) => 1;

name: M7 definite var
text: let x!: number, y: string, z!: boolean;

name: M8 const enum
text: const enum E { A } export const enum F { B }

name: M9 abstract class
text: abstract class A {} export abstract class B {}

name: M10 export default abstract
text: export default abstract class {}

name: M11 import type specifiers
text: import { type A, B, type C as D, type as, type as as, type as as as, type "s" as E, type default as F } from "m";

name: M12 export type specifiers
text: export { type A, B, type C as D, type as, type as as, type as as as };

name: M13 export from type specifiers
text: export { type default as X, type A as default, type "s" as T } from "m";

name: M14 decorator nonnull
text: class A { @a!.b! x; @c!() y; }

name: M16 member named like modifier
text: class A { readonly; public = 1; static() {} declare: number; abstract; static static; async; get; }

name: M17 index signature modifiers
text: class A { static readonly [k: string]: number; }

name: M18 accessor pairs
text: class A { public static get x() { return 1 } private set y(v) {} }

name: M19 decorated params
text: class A { constructor(@d private x: number) {} m(@d a?: number) {} }

name: M20 this param
text: function f(this: Window, a: number) {}

name: M21 in/out/const type params ignored here
text: class A { public constructor() {} private static async *gen() {} }
